steps.title: System packages
steps.note: Plus the GStreamer plugins and ffmpeg for the media side, and python for the optional venvs. Rust and Bun through their own installers.

steps.title: Build and install
steps.note: Runs the release build, copies the binary to ~/.local/bin/vela-bin, then smoke-tests it: if the process does not stay up, the script stops and shows you the log.

steps.title: Optional tools, in the background
steps.note: Dedicated venvs for demucs (about 3 GB of torch on first run) and for yt-dlp with spotdl, plus tesseract and pandoc if you want OCR and conversion. Skip the stems with VELA_SKIP_STEMS=1.

steps.title: Launch it
steps.note: Wrap that in ~/.local/bin/vela and bind it: bind = SUPER, E, exec, ~/.local/bin/vela. install.sh also writes the desktop entry and the D-Bus service.
